system.description:
The mage senses and redirects electrical and electromagnetic currents, rerouting power, overloading a circuit, or dimming and brightening lights. At rank 2 the caster perceives and manipulates existing energy flows rather than creating them. Useful for disabling cameras, cutting alarms, or powering a dead device.

Dice Pool: Wits + Technology (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Forces 2; mechanics paraphrased.
